attempted_claim: Let p be odd, n ≥ 1, q = p^n, S ∈ Syl_p(3D4(q)). Use van Beek §5 notation: Q1 = C_S(Z_2(S)), |Q1| = q^11, Φ(Q1) = Q1' = Z_3(S) elementary abelian of order q^5; Q2 semiextraspecial of order q^9 with Z(S) = Z(Q2) of order q and Q2/Z(S) an 8-dimensional F_q-module; |S| = q^12, S' = Φ(S) = Q1 ∩ Q2, Out_S(Q2) elementary abelian of order q^3. Let F be a saturated fusion system on S in which Q2 is essential. Without assuming Aut_F(Q2) is a K-group, prove O^{p'}(Out_F(Q2)) ≅ SL_2(q^3) with Q2/Z(S) a triality module (the unique non-trivial composition factor identified in the proof of Theorem 5.19), and deduce outcomes (1)–(4) of Theorem 5.19 unconditionally; in particular, if O_p(F) = 1 and E(F) = {Q1, Q2} then F = F_S(G) with F^*(G) = O^{p'}(G) = 3D4(q).
decisive_failure: The unconditional SL_2(q^3) automizer identification remains open: all three concrete routes (Henke FF-modules, Ho TI-set plus Proposition 2.34, weak BN-pair uniqueness) terminate at the Parker-Stroth/GLS strongly-p-embedded classification step, and the q=3 recovery test confirms the gap is structural rather than numerical. WORKLOG and exit files record the obstruction precisely.
